# Vendored: swift-cmark (cmark-gfm)

- Source: https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-cmark
- Tag: `0.9.0`
- Commit: `08ddb528923cc1a6527e02b7a1aee9e516ca749a`
- License: see `COPYING` (BSD-2-Clause and others listed there)

Copied unmodified: `src/`, `extensions/`, `COPYING`.
Left out: CLI (`bin/`), tests, fuzzers, benchmarks, CMake files, man pages, wrappers.
`Package.swift` is ours: it declares only the two library targets.

`src/scanners.c` and `extensions/ext_scanners.c` are generated by re2c from the
`.re` files next to them. Upstream commits the generated C; it was not regenerated here.

To upgrade: clone the new tag, diff `src/` and `extensions/` against this copy,
review the diff, copy, and update the tag and commit above.
